# /crav1-run-exploratory-test

lane: cross-cutting | group: Testing helpers | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.16.0 | prompts: 0
purpose: After a build of a slice already exists, use the slice in two passes and write down bugs.
use_when: A build of a slice already exists
reads: Reads a built slice, `spec.md`, and `plan.md`.
writes: Writes bugs in `docs/specs/<slug>/explore.md`.
leaves alone: Leaves `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, application code, and the checks the plan already named alone.
limits: no build of the slice stops with nothing written. The second pass stops at `matched the first pass`, or sooner at `the user said stop`. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not a starter option.
flow:
- When a build of a slice already exists, **`/crav1-run-exploratory-test`** uses that slice in two passes and writes down bugs.
- That stop is named `matched the first pass`.
- That stop is named `the user said stop`.
- It writes `docs/specs/<slug>/explore.md`.
- A bug it finds is not sent to `/crav1-fix-bug` unless the user says so in that turn.
- After a build of a slice already exists, uses the slice once, then again with randomness, and writes bugs to `docs/specs/<slug>/explore.md`.
- The second pass lasts about as long as the first, then stops (`matched the first pass`), or sooner when the user says stop (`the user said stop`).
- A bug is not sent to `/crav1-fix-bug` unless the user says so in that turn.
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls `/crav1-fix-bug` only when the user says so in that turn.
you run next: /crav1-finalize-commit
first: `/crav1-run-exploratory-test @docs/specs/<slug>/ Use the slice once, then again with randomness. Write down bugs. Do not start Specify, Plan, or Build.`
walkthrough: from-run-exploratory-test.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.207.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-run-exploratory-test.md
